verdict.rationale: Codegen documents agents that install dependencies and run code in isolated sandboxes, plus an endpoint where the agent analyzes the repository structure and generates its own setup commands. A companion endpoint analyzes sandbox setup logs to diagnose failures, which covers self-configuration of the working environment. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the agent clones the repo itself (only implied by GitHub App repo access), detail on how environment configuration persists or is customized, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
